title: Every Kid Gets a Cloud. Mine Hasn't Opened in Ten Years. (Part 1)
summary: Fold and Nell try to save his ten-year cloud from the king, and three answering thunderclaps frighten the royal dragon.
frame_0: In the sunny square, Fold stands in a puddle below his ten-year storm cloud. Nell and her hawk stand beside him. The wolf perches on its white cloud, the royal dragon rests on the gallery, and the crossbow rolls into place.
package_differences: Jake requested one continuous moving camera throughout the story. The camera visits the wolf, griffin and dragon in sequence during the age comparison.
The approved corner handle covers the story. The supplied five-second Flashloop card retains its original picture and audio.
